🌻 Welcome to Plant Brainrot Simulator!

Grow plants, smack Brainrots, and survive endless goofy waves!
Upgrade, rebirth, and become the strongest garden defender. 🌱🧠

✨ Premium = +25% Coins
🎮 How to Play

• Plant Seeds – Your plants auto-attack incoming Brainrots!
• Earn Coins – Defeat enemies to upgrade and unlock stronger plants.
• Survive Waves – Push higher waves and climb the leaderboard.
• Rebirth – Unlock new seeds and boost your growth permanently.
